method.note_on_earlier_bootstrap: the four llama3:8b C109 bootstrap intervals already in the register came from analyze_c109.py::stratified_bootstrap_ci, a STRATIFIED bootstrap at B = 5000, seed 42. This run uses the plain percentile bootstrap at B = 10000, the construction accord/control/report.py uses everywhere else in the thesis, so all 17 cells are now on one method; the llama3:8b numbers here therefore need not equal the stratified ones already registered.

summary.mirror_note: Chapter 5 defines a bounded null as an interval that contains chance AND ends below the simulated Mann-Whitney floor. The mirror image is an interval that excludes chance AND begins above that floor. The first half is met by 12 of 17 cells on G_253. The second half is met by none, on G_253 or on either stratum. A labeller cell may therefore be said to exclude chance; it may not be said to clear this study's own detectability floor with its interval.
summary.duplicate_note: P_reversed_rerun is C109's determinism re-run of C103's P_reversed on the same model and the same 299 pairs. It reproduces P_reversed's AUROC to every printed digit, which is what a passing determinism check means. The 17 configurations therefore contain 2 duplicate pairs and cover 15 distinct model-and-wording cells; a count of 17 must not be read as 17 independent wordings.
